$comment: Structs JS writes into native memory and passes by pointer. scripts/gen-native-types.mjs turns each into a NATIVE_STRUCTS entry (src/utils/native-exports.generated.ts) for defineNativeStruct() in src/utils/native-memory.ts. Field types: f32, i32, u32, ptr; every field is 4 bytes, in declaration order. `countsKey` names the scripts/memory-layout.mjs COUNTS entry that must equal the field count; `reader` is the native function that reads it.

CollisionObject.doc: One collision object in the BATCH_UPLOAD region. type and flags are stored as f32 and cast to i32 on read.
